title: EP1 — In the Mood for Love
content: Lost Frames S1E1. Wong Kar-wai's 'In the Mood for Love' (2000) — 98 minutes on screen, but Wong shot for fifteen months and left whole years of footage on the cutting room floor. This is the story of the frames he lost.
excerpt: Lost Frames S1E1. Wong Kar-wai's 'In the Mood for Love' (2000) — 98 minutes — and the lost frames that almost made it three hours long.
